_comment: The statement the Edge Functions' IAM key needs on top of its object
permissions. Presigning only ever touches one key at a time, so the key
was never granted s3:ListBucket — and delete-track lists tracks/<id>/
before it deletes, so that it removes superseded artwork nothing in the
database references any more. Without this it fails with list failed (403).
ListBucket is granted on the BUCKET arn, not on objects; the condition
keeps it to the tracks prefix.
